about: Commentary script database. 'barks' are instant one-liners (only {team} and {opponent} slots, so they can be pre-generated as audio). 'lines' are follow-ups with any slot; the AI director picks and stitches them. pbp = play-by-play commentator, color = analyst. A line is only used when every slot in it has a value.

slots.team: team that acted (scored, shot, saved, has the ball)
slots.score_line: full spoken score: 'three-two to Red', 'all square at two-all'
slots.team_goals: goals of the acting team, in words
slots.lead: size of the lead, in words (only when someone leads)
slots.trail_by: how many goals the acting team still trails by, in words
slots.deficit: biggest deficit the acting team came back from, in words
slots.streak: goals in a row by the acting team, in words
slots.drought: time without a goal before this one: 'ninety seconds'
slots.shot_speed: speed of the shot that was saved
slots.record: fastest shot of the match so far
slots.goals_to_win: goals needed to win the match, in words
slots.saves_team: saves by the acting team, in words
slots.shots_fewer: the other team's shot count, in words
slots.busy_team: team whose defence has made the most saves
slots.busy_saves: their number of saves, in words
slots.hot_team: team that scored the last goals in a row
slots.hot_streak: how many in a row, in words
slots.mp_team: team that is one goal from winning
